USAGE:
  sediment transcript [snapshot] --agent {claude-code,codex,pi}

  Read a JSON hook event from stdin and emit Edit observations. Configure a
  capture endpoint before running this command.

ARGUMENTS:
  {snapshot}            capture pre-edit line hashes from a PreToolUse event;
                        place snapshot before --agent, or omit it for a
                        SessionEnd event

OPTIONS:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --agent {claude-code,codex,pi}
                        transcript's agent harness
